def is_ok(k):
    itr = -1
    for i in range(tl):
        q = itr // sl
        r = itr % sl
        a = ord(T[i]) - ord("a")
        if cnt[a] == 0: return False
        now = cnt[a] * q + bisect.bisect_right(ind[a], r)
        next = now + k
        nq = next // cnt[a]
        nr = next % cnt[a]
        if nr == 0:
            nq -= 1
            nr += cnt[a]
        itr = nq * sl + ind[a][nr - 1]
        if itr >= N * sl:
            return False
    return True
